item.ptxt: Before removal, check for mud or other dirt around the pipe and connector, and wipe it off if present.
If the connector and pipe are stuck, pinch the retainer by hand and push and pull to release the connection and pull it out. Do not use tools at this time.
When disconnecting, cover the connection with a shop rag or equivalent to prevent fuel from splashing.
Inspect the sealing surface of the removed pipe for mud, etc., and wipe it off if present.
